Upon arrival at Shanghai International Airport, you will be warmly greeted by our Yana Travels professional English speaking guide. You will be transferred by Maglev train to Shanghai City. Check into your hotel either Park Inn by Radisson or a similar 4-star property. After check-in, you'll have time to unwind and relax from your journey. In the evening, enjoy a delightful Indian dinner arranged at a local restaurant. This day offers a gentle introduction to the vibrant energy of Shanghai while preparing you for the days ahead.
